# Support

Start with the [package documentation](https://packages.rentner.dev/packages/menu), [README](../README.md), and [usage guide](../docs/usage.md). Check that the documentation matches your installed version of @rentnerkev/menu.

For reproducible bugs or feature requests, search [existing issues](https://github.com/RentnerKev/RentnerMenu/issues), then open an issue using the available template. Include the package version, React version, browser, a minimal reproduction, and expected versus actual behavior. Remove secrets and personal information from code, logs, and screenshots.

Usage questions can be opened as an issue with a small example and a clear description of what you are trying to achieve. Maintainer help is provided as time permits; there is no guaranteed response time or commercial support commitment.

To contribute a fix, see [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md). For conduct concerns, see the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Report security vulnerabilities privately according to the [security policy](../SECURITY.md), rather than through support issues.
